quotes.text: The FCC’s last-ditch effort to regulate campaign advertising before the most important election in our nation’s history is undoubtedly rooted in partisan politics. This clearly marks an abuse of regulatory authority, which is why we must prohibit Americans’ hard-earned tax dollars from funding the FCC’s misguided attempt to regulate political speech.
